headline: Saints Believe LT Kelvin Banks Jr. Suffered High Ankle Sprain
summary: The Saints recorded a comeback win on Sunday but their offense was dealt a notable blow in the process. Left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. was carted off the field, and he appears to be in line to miss time. New Orleans believes Banks suffered a high ankle sprain yesterday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports. An MRI […]
